headline: Every review marker states its whole reason, and the vendored PKI bundle moves to 0.7.39
summary: A comment sweep in 0.19.0 removed the second line of eleven `allow:` review markers and five `drop-silent` statements, leaving each a half-sentence in shipped source. All sixteen are whole sentences again, the comment gate now fails a block that ends on a comma or a semicolon or opens a parenthesis it never closes, and the vendored `@blamejs/pki` bundle rises to 0.7.39. Upgrading requires no code change.

items.title: Sixteen comments in `lib/` are whole sentences again
items.body: The 0.19.0 comment sweep kept a line that carries an `allow:` review marker or a `drop-silent` statement and removed the line after it. Where the reason ran onto that second line the shipped file carried half of it: `crypto-field.js` ended its marker on "operator", `dsr.js` opened a parenthesis it never closed, and `app-shutdown.js`, `audit.js`, `db-declare-row-policy.js`, `metrics.js`, `middleware/attach-user.js`, `middleware/span-http-server.js`, `middleware/idempotency-key.js` and `network-smtp-policy.js` each ended on a comma, a semicolon or a noun the rest of the sentence was meant to follow. Five `drop-silent` statements in `error-page.js`, `http-client.js`, `pqc-agent.js`, `safe-decompress.js` and `session-device-binding.js` were cut the same way. Each is one sentence on one line now, with the same claim it made before the sweep; every marker's claim was re-read against the code it annotates and holds.

items.title: Vendored `@blamejs/pki` moves to 0.7.39
items.body: The vendored bundle rises from 0.7.37 to 0.7.39. `pki.lint.certificate` grades six more RFC 5280 rules (policy mapping to or from anyPolicy, unique identifiers present, and four more its parser had read past), `pki.schema.x509.parse` returns `issuerUniqueID` and `subjectUniqueID`, and `pki.schema.ocsp.parseRequest` and `parseResponse` refuse a CertID whose issuer hashes are not the length of the digest they name, with the digest lengths shared through `pki.constants.NAMES.DIGEST_OCTETS`. The package continues to declare no dependencies and no install, prepare or prepublish scripts.

items.title: A comment block that ends on `,` or `;`, or opens a parenthesis it never closes, fails the whole-sentence gate
items.body: The gate that keeps `lib/` comments whole sentences judged a block's last word against a list of function words, so a block cut after a noun passed. It now also fails a block whose last line ends on a comma or a semicolon, or that opens a parenthesis it never closes. On the tree before this release it reported eleven of the sixteen blocks above and nothing else; the other five ended on a noun and were found by comparing each marker with its text before the sweep.
